post.description:
Sign in with email and password, into the oldest business the person belongs to.

An unknown email and a wrong password get the same answer, and cost the same time.

delete.description: Sign out this browser. Needs no live session: an expired cookie is cleared all the same.
Sign the user out of every session, in every tenant.

post.description: Send a link that sets up a business, or, if the email has an account, a note to sign in.
Create the business and its owner from a sign-up link, and sign the owner in.
Send a reset link; for an unknown email the email job sends nothing, after this answer.

Set a new password from a reset link. The person is signed out everywhere, and so is this
browser, whoever was signed in on it; they sign in again with the new password.

get.description: The business's events, newest first. The next page is before= the last id of this one.

put.description: Save the keys sent; keys left out keep their value. Every change goes in the audit log.

get.description:
Every service of the business, archived ones included; the booking flow (ZIF-51) is what
filters those out for new bookings.

ponytail: no pagination, since a business has tens of services. Add before= as in audit.py if
one ever has hundreds.

Every member of this business, in a stable order. Row-level security limits it to the
business; the email is personal data, so only an owner sees it.

patch.description:
Make a member an owner or a worker. They are signed out of this business, so their next
request carries the new role; their sessions in other businesses stay.

delete.description: Remove a member from this business. Their sessions here end with the membership.

get.description: A member's working hours, Monday first. Anyone in the business may read them.

put.description:
Replace a member's whole week. An owner changes anyone's; a worker only their own, and only
if the business allows it.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Every API error body: a stable code the web app translates, never prose.

ServiceChange.title: ServiceChange
ServiceChange.description:
Only the fields sent change. buffer_minutes may be null (back to the business's default); no
other field may. name and description are replaced whole, not merged per language: the web app
always sends every language it holds.
